note: Pilot-level help for lagging brain motor contracts (haltere.liftoff.fast_race_cue.MotorAssistConfig; visual_brain --motor-assist on|off|DECLARATION, off by default; sidecar pilot_assistance.motor_assist and motor_assist_declaration; CSV assist_* columns only when on). Version 4 of the rule (round 6, branch m6-brake): version 3 (configs/pilot/motor_assist_v3.json, 7c3b49e7...) without the approach source, with a tracking floor while no wall is confirmed ahead, and with the ceiling cut bounding only the assist's share of a climb. Versions 1-3 are kept for provenance and replays and refused by the runner. Declared per motor contract, never per course or per brain; the fast PD contract has no entry and flies bit-identically with the flag on. Causal and course-agnostic as version 3.
rule: Version 3's cap tracking (request, governor, turn_first and stopping sources; slew 15 m/s^2; the stopping source only under turn-first's wall-ahead conditions, with its 1 s memory; no governor tracking during its stand-off) and sag compensation, with: (a) no approach source: live, minus-brain11cw13-r5-02, version 3's approach cut the request 6 -> 1.3 -> -0.2 m/s in front of the first Minus Two arch with the ring in view and centred, and the brain crawled into the arch (early braking toward a surface is now the looming governor's early brake, on the pilot's own request); (b) track_floor: unless the stopping source binds (a wall confirmed under a wall-ahead condition), cap tracking of the request and governor sources never lowers a bound below min(the bound, track_floor); (c) ceiling_share: while the pilot climbs toward its ring in view (state cue), the assist's sag climb no longer removes the pilot's exemption from the ceiling guard's any_climb cut; overhead evidence confirmed during the assist's sag climb starts a separate hold that bounds only the assist's share of the climb to the guard's vertical_cap (round-5 review: on straw-brain08-06 the whole climb was held at 0 m/s for 0.89 s, open loop).

parameter_notes.unchanged: every version-3 value; floor_speed and approach_climb_max belong to the approach source, which version 4 does not have
parameter_notes.track_floor: 2.5 m/s, the early brake's floor: the assist never asks a lagging brain for less than 2.5 m/s with no wall confirmed ahead, where version 3 asked for 0.02-0.16 m/s at the Minus Two arches in open-loop replays of the development logs
parameter_notes.ceiling_share: true: the fix the round-5 live-plan amendment asked for
